# Royal Software Solutions — Fahari

> Royal Software Solutions is a Nairobi-based enterprise software company
> building the Fahari product suite: an integrated institutional operating
> system for East African schools, businesses, SACCOs, and NGOs.
> Products are cloud-based, M-Pesa integrated, and go live in 24 hours.

Key facts:

- Founded in Kenya; primary market is East Africa (Kenya, Uganda, Tanzania)
- Core product suite: Fahari Academia (schools), Fahari Nexus (businesses), Fahari Ledger (SACCOs)
- Compliance: CBC/KCSE/IGCSE curriculum aligned (Academia); SASRA compliant (Ledger)
- Pricing: subscription-based, KES-denominated, M-Pesa billing supported
- Contact: +254 759 437 978
- WhatsApp: https://wa.me/254759437978
- Demo requests: https://royalsoftwares.co.ke/get-quote

## Products

- [Fahari Academia](https://royalsoftwares.co.ke/fahari-academia): School management ERP for East African institutions. CBC/KCSE/IGCSE-aligned fee collection, report cards, HR, payroll, and parent portal. Go live in 24 hours.
- [Fahari Nexus](https://royalsoftwares.co.ke/fahari-nexus): Business operations ERP for African SMEs and enterprises. Sales, inventory, procurement, finance, and HR — unified. M-Pesa integrated.
- [Fahari Ledger](https://royalsoftwares.co.ke/fahari-ledger): SACCO and microfinance management system. SASRA-compliant loan tracking, member records, dividends, and mobile banking. Built for Kenya.
